scene: You climb onto the airy rooftop transit hub.
picture: A flat side-view along the level rooftop terminal. Far left, a glass-roofed trolley sits waiting at a gate. Left, the woman in lilac headscarf and mustard coat steps off the roof ladder. Centre stands a ticket booth. Up high hangs an enclosed cable tram. Far right, an aqueduct barge rests beside a gangway.
shown: a sleek glass-roofed trolley idling at an open platform gate on the far left
an enclosed mountain cable tram hanging from an overhead line up high
a wooden river barge canal lock with an open boarding gangway far right
